text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated stance","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a defensible position up front and keeps that position visible throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"“if the car could malfunction… crash” and “decrease… speeding tickets, DUI's, and accidents”","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"It presents both benefits and drawbacks of driverless cars instead of arguing in only one direction."},{"evidence":"“What’s the point… if you still have to be behind the wheel?”","quality":"argumentative framing","description":"It uses a direct rhetorical challenge to make the central claim feel more forceful and debatable."},{"evidence":"“malfunction… crash into a building or innocent bystanders”","quality":"specific support","description":"It develops claims with concrete consequences rather than relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"“they could decrease the number of speeding tickets, DUI’s, and accidents”","quality":"control of evidence","description":"It connects article details to the argument in a clearer, more relevant way."},{"evidence":"“Only time will tell” conclusion","quality":"conclusion development","description":"It ends with a more cohesive wrap-up that summarizes the uncertainty and overall judgment."}]}
